name: Tea (Ceremonial Matcha Detail)
description: Stunning 3D showcase of ceremonial Japanese matcha tea. An antique textured black raku chawan tea bowl filled with rich frothy emerald-green matcha, next to a bamboo whisk with crimson binding and a pile of vibrant green tea powder on a dark lacquer tray, illuminated with dramatic crimson backlighting.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of ceremonial Japanese matcha tea. An authentic textured pitch-black raku ceramic tea bowl filled with frothy emerald green matcha, a carved bamboo chasen whisk with crimson red silk cord binding, and fine green tea powder on a black lacquer wooden tray. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), dramatic crimson red (#FF2035) studio lighting and red rim light, hyper-detailed textures, 8k render, no text.
